lesson.grammar_point: presentation signposting (Today I'm going to talk about / First, Next, Finally / As you can see / To sum up)

listenings.text: Good morning, everybody. I'm Tom, from New Jersey. Today I'm going to show you two numbers. First, production: it increased by eight percent this quarter. Next, energy: the cost of energy decreased, because we have new machines. To sum up, it was a good quarter for New Jersey. Thank you.

Hi Rodrigo, it's Nora. For your presentation in New York, you have ten minutes and a big screen in the main meeting room. Please send me your slides on Monday. My tip: start with one big number, and finish with a short summary. People here love short presentations!

extra_audio.text: Rodrigo opened: today I'm going to talk about three KPIs. First, he showed the chart of delivery. Next, he explained that the cost decreased. Finally, he talked about safety. To sum up, he said it was a good quarter, and he answered questions.
